title: Binder Term and Acceptance Days: Cases for Wayfare Driver Insurance Binders
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, the term an insurance binder prints, from its upload date to its printed end date, bears on the binder acceptance days: the calendar days from the recording day for which a recorded binder is accepted as the auto insurance on file.

## Rule

When the binder's printed end date lies at least 60 calendar days after its upload date, the binder acceptance days gain 10 days; when it lies at least 30 but fewer than 60 days after, they gain 5 days; when it lies fewer than 30 days after, they gain none.

The binder is the latest auto insurance upload on the standing record; its upload date and printed end date are the date and the expiry date shown on that upload entry.

| Days from upload date to printed end date | Days gained |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 10 |
| 30 to 59 | 5 |
| 29 or fewer | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical binders)

**Case A.** Uploaded 2026-06-01, printed end date 2026-07-31: 60 days. Gains 10.

**Case B.** Uploaded 2026-06-01, printed end date 2026-07-30: 59 days. Gains 5.

**Case C.** Uploaded 2026-06-01, printed end date 2026-07-01: 30 days. Gains 5.

**Case D.** Uploaded 2026-06-01, printed end date 2026-06-30: 29 days. Gains none.

The recording day plays no part in this term; only the two dates on the upload entry do.
